# The 2025 LLM Usage Landscape: Real-World Data from OpenRouter

## Data Source
OpenRouter is one of the largest LLM API aggregation platforms, capturing real usage data from millions of users. The data below is sourced from the OpenRouter Rankings page (https://openrouter.ai/rankings) and covers the most recent week of March 2025.

## Weekly Model Usage Trends

![March 2025 – March 2026 OpenRouter weekly token usage stacked bar chart (total growing from ~2T to ~26T)](./assets/chart_top_models_trend.png)

## This Week's Top 10 Models

![This week's LLM Leaderboard Top 10](./assets/table_leaderboard.png)

| Rank | Model | Provider | Weekly Token Usage | WoW Change |
|:---:|------|------|:---:|:---:|
| 1 | MiMo-V2-Pro | Xiaomi | 3.96T | +165% |
| 2 | Step 3.5 Flash (free) | Stepfun | 1.49T | +1% |
| 3 | MiniMax M2.7 | MiniMax | 1.29T | +253% |
| 4 | DeepSeek V3.2 | DeepSeek | 1.24T | +9% |
| 5 | Claude Sonnet 4.6 | Anthropic | 1.04T | -0% |
| 6 | Claude Opus 4.6 | Anthropic | 995B | +2% |
| 7 | Gemini 3 Flash Preview | Google | 972B | +3% |
| 8 | GLM 5 Turbo | Zhipu (z-ai) | 968B | -6% |
| 9 | MiniMax M2.5 | MiniMax | 909B | -30% |
| 10 | Grok 4.1 Fast | x-ai | 599B | +32% |

**Key Findings**:
- Chinese providers hold 6 of the top 10 spots (Xiaomi, Stepfun, MiniMax ×2, DeepSeek, Zhipu)
- Xiaomi's MiMo-V2-Pro leads by a wide margin at 3.96T tokens, with 165% week-over-week growth
- MiniMax M2.7 posted the strongest growth at +253% week-over-week
- Anthropic's two models (Sonnet 4.6 + Opus 4.6) combine for roughly 2T tokens, but growth has stalled

## Provider Market Share (by Token Volume)

![Provider market share trend (stacked area chart)](./assets/chart_market_share.png)

![Provider market share ranking](./assets/table_market_share.png)

| Rank | Provider | Weekly Token Volume | Market Share |
|:---:|------|:---:|:---:|
| 1 | Xiaomi | 1.31T | 25.9% |
| 2 | Google | 594B | 11.8% |
| 3 | Anthropic | 555B | 11.0% |
| 4 | MiniMax | 429B | 8.5% |
| 5 | OpenAI | 400B | 7.9% |
| 6 | Stepfun | 341B | 6.8% |
| 7 | DeepSeek | 334B | 6.6% |
| 8 | Zhipu (z-ai) | 326B | 6.5% |
| 9 | x-ai | 195B | 3.9% |
| 10 | Others | 563B | 11.2% |

**Key Findings**:
- Xiaomi leads decisively at 25.9%, more than double the second-place Google
- Combined Chinese provider share: Xiaomi + MiniMax + Stepfun + DeepSeek + Zhipu ≈ 54.3%, exceeding half the market
- OpenAI ranks only fifth at 7.9%
- The market is highly fragmented — no single provider exceeds 30%

## Fastest-Growing Models

| Model | Provider | WoW Growth |
|------|------|:---:|
| MiniMax M2.7 | MiniMax | +253% |
| MiMo-V2-Pro | Xiaomi | +165% |
| Cline (coding agent) | Independent developer | +128% |
| Hermes Agent | Nous Research | +92% |
| Ampere | Ampere | +576% |
| Codex | OpenAI | +112% |

## Top Apps (by Daily Token Consumption)

![Top Apps ranking](./assets/table_top_apps.png)

| Rank | App | Description | Daily Token Volume |
|:---:|------|------|:---:|
| 1 | OpenClaw | AI productivity assistant — "The AI that actually does things" | 829B |
| 2 | Kilo Code | VS Code AI coding assistant | 271B |
| 3 | Claude Code | Anthropic's CLI coding tool | 78B |
| 4 | Cline | VS Code autonomous coding agent | 69.1B |
| 5 | Janitor AI | Character roleplay chat | 29.2B |
| 6 | ISEKAI ZERO | AI adventure game | 28.8B |
| 7 | Descript | AI video/podcast editor | 27B |
| 8 | Hermes Agent | Nous Research's AI agent | 19.2B |
| 9 | Roo Code | VS Code AI coding assistant | 11.8B |
| 10 | Scripty | Newly launched tool | 9.95B |

**Key Findings**:
- The top 4 apps are all **AI coding tools** (OpenClaw, Kilo Code, Claude Code, Cline)
- AI coding agents have become the single largest LLM consumption scenario
- Entertainment/roleplay apps (Janitor AI, ISEKAI ZERO) still hold a notable presence
- OpenClaw consumes 829B tokens per day — nearly 3× the second-place app

## Industry Trend Observations

1. **Chinese Models Break Through Globally**: On OpenRouter, an international platform, Chinese provider models now account for over half of all usage. Xiaomi's MiMo series, DeepSeek V3, and MiniMax's M2 series hold a significant cost-performance advantage.

2. **Flash/Turbo Variants Outpace Flagship Models**: Step 3.5 Flash, GLM 5 Turbo, Gemini 3 Flash, and other "fast and affordable" models see far higher usage than their flagship counterparts. Users are voting with their feet — in real-world applications, speed and cost often matter more than peak performance.

3. **AI Coding Agents Dominate Usage**: 5 of the top 10 apps are coding tools. This reflects the largest commercial value proposition for LLMs today — helping developers write code.

4. **A Highly Fragmented Market**: No single model or provider monopolizes the market. The top 10 spans 8 different providers, signaling that competition remains fierce and the landscape is far from settled.

from pptx.chart.data import CategoryChartData
import math

prs.slide_height = Inches(7.5)

# Colors
BG = RGBColor(0x0F, 0x17, 0x2A)
ACCENT = RGBColor(0x00, 0xD4, 0xAA)
WHITE = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF)
LIGHT = RGBColor(0xB0, 0xBC, 0xD4)
CARD_BG = RGBColor(0x1A, 0x25, 0x3C)
RED = RGBColor(0xFF, 0x6B, 0x6B)
GREEN = RGBColor(0x00, 0xE6, 0x96)
ORANGE = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xA5, 0x00)
YELLOW = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xD7, 0x00)

def set_bg(slide):
    bg = slide.background
    fill = bg.fill
    fill.solid()
    fill.fore_color.rgb = BG

def add_text(slide, left, top, width, height, text, size=18, color=WHITE, bold=False, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, font_name="Calibri"):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = text
    p.font.size = Pt(size)
    p.font.color.rgb = color
    p.font.bold = bold
    p.font.name = font_name
    p.alignment = align
    return txBox

def add_rect(slide, left, top, width, height, color=CARD_BG):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(1, left, top, width, height)  # MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = color
    shape.line.fill.background()
    return shape

def slide_title(slide, title_text):
    add_text(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(0.4), Inches(11), Inches(0.7), title_text, size=32, color=ACCENT, bold=True)
    # Divider line
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(1, Inches(0.8), Inches(1.15), Inches(11.5), Pt(2))
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = ACCENT
    shape.line.fill.background()

# ── Slide 1: Title ──
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])  # blank
set_bg(slide)
add_text(slide, Inches(1.5), Inches(1.5), Inches(10), Inches(1.5),
         "The 2025 LLM Usage Landscape:\nReal-World Data from OpenRouter",
         size=40, color=WHITE, bold=True, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
add_text(slide, Inches(2), Inches(3.3), Inches(9), Inches(0.6),
         "Based on real usage data from millions of OpenRouter users",
         size=20, color=LIGHT, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

# Headline metric box
add_rect(slide, Inches(4), Inches(4.3), Inches(5.3), Inches(1.4), CARD_BG)
add_text(slide, Inches(4.2), Inches(4.4), Inches(5), Inches(0.7),
         "26T+", size=48, color=ACCENT, bold=True, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
add_text(slide, Inches(4.2), Inches(5.1), Inches(5), Inches(0.5),
         "Tokens processed this week", size=18, color=LIGHT, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

add_text(slide, Inches(3), Inches(6.3), Inches(7), Inches(0.4),
         "Source: OpenRouter Rankings  ·  Latest week of March 2025",
         size=14, color=LIGHT, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

# ── Slide 2: Top 10 Models (Table) ──
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
set_bg(slide)
slide_title(slide, "This Week's Top 10 Models")

models = [
    ("1", "MiMo-V2-Pro", "Xiaomi", "3.96T", "+165%"),
    ("2", "Step 3.5 Flash (free)", "Stepfun", "1.49T", "+1%"),
    ("3", "MiniMax M2.7", "MiniMax", "1.29T", "+253%"),
    ("4", "DeepSeek V3.2", "DeepSeek", "1.24T", "+9%"),
    ("5", "Claude Sonnet 4.6", "Anthropic", "1.04T", "-0%"),
    ("6", "Claude Opus 4.6", "Anthropic", "995B", "+2%"),
    ("7", "Gemini 3 Flash Preview", "Google", "972B", "+3%"),
    ("8", "GLM 5 Turbo", "Zhipu (z-ai)", "968B", "-6%"),
    ("9", "MiniMax M2.5", "MiniMax", "909B", "-30%"),
    ("10", "Grok 4.1 Fast", "x-ai", "599B", "+32%"),
]

rows = 11
cols = 5
tbl_left = Inches(0.8)
tbl_top = Inches(1.5)
tbl_w = Inches(11.5)
tbl_h = Inches(5.5)

table_shape = slide.shapes.add_table(rows, cols, tbl_left, tbl_top, tbl_w, tbl_h)
table = table_shape.table

col_widths = [Inches(0.8), Inches(3.5), Inches(2.0), Inches(2.5), Inches(2.7)]
for i, w in enumerate(col_widths):
    table.columns[i].width = w

headers = ["Rank", "Model", "Provider", "Weekly Tokens", "WoW Change"]
for i, h in enumerate(headers):
    cell = table.cell(0, i)
    cell.text = h
    for p in cell.text_frame.paragraphs:
        p.font.size = Pt(14)
        p.font.bold = True
        p.font.color.rgb = BG
        p.font.name = "Calibri"
        p.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
    cell.fill.solid()
    cell.fill.fore_color.rgb = ACCENT
    cell.vertical_anchor = MSO_ANCHOR.MIDDLE

for r, row_data in enumerate(models):
    for c, val in enumerate(row_data):
        cell = table.cell(r + 1, c)
        cell.text = val
        for p in cell.text_frame.paragraphs:
            p.font.size = Pt(13)
            p.font.color.rgb = WHITE
            p.font.name = "Calibri"
            p.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
            if c == 4:
                if val.startswith("+") and val not in ("+0%", "-0%"):
                    p.font.color.rgb = GREEN
                elif val.startswith("-") and val != "-0%":
                    p.font.color.rgb = RED
        cell.fill.solid()
        cell.fill.fore_color.rgb = CARD_BG if r % 2 == 0 else BG
        cell.vertical_anchor = MSO_ANCHOR.MIDDLE

# Highlight row 1
for c in range(cols):
    cell = table.cell(1, c)
    cell.fill.solid()
    cell.fill.fore_color.rgb = RGBColor(0x14, 0x3A, 0x2E)

# ── Slide 3: Market Share (Pie chart via shapes) ──
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
set_bg(slide)
slide_title(slide, "Provider Market Share Breakdown")

providers_data = [
    ("Xiaomi", 25.9, RGBColor(0x00, 0xD4, 0xAA)),
    ("Google", 11.8, RGBColor(0x42, 0x85, 0xF4)),
    ("Anthropic", 11.0, RGBColor(0xD4, 0x8A, 0x00)),
    ("MiniMax", 8.5, RGBColor(0xFF, 0x6B, 0x6B)),
    ("OpenAI", 7.9, RGBColor(0x74, 0xB9, 0xFF)),
    ("Stepfun", 6.8, RGBColor(0xA8, 0x5C, 0xFF)),
    ("DeepSeek", 6.6, RGBColor(0xFF, 0xA5, 0x00)),
    ("Zhipu", 6.5, RGBColor(0x00, 0xE6, 0x96)),
    ("x-ai", 3.9, RGBColor(0xFF, 0xD7, 0x00)),
    ("Others", 11.2, RGBColor(0x60, 0x6E, 0x85)),
]

# Use a bar chart instead for clarity
chart_data = CategoryChartData()
chart_data.categories = [p[0] for p in providers_data]
chart_data.add_series("Market Share %", [p[1] for p in providers_data])

chart_frame = slide.shapes.add_chart(
    XL_CHART_TYPE.BAR_CLUSTERED, Inches(0.8), Inches(1.5), Inches(7), Inches(5.5),
    chart_data
)
chart = chart_frame.chart
chart.has_legend = False

plot = chart.plots[0]
plot.gap_width = 80
series = plot.series[0]
series.format.fill.solid()
series.format.fill.fore_color.rgb = ACCENT

for i, pt_data in enumerate(providers_data):
    point = series.points[i]
    point.format.fill.solid()
    point.format.fill.fore_color.rgb = pt_data[2]

series.has_data_labels = True
data_labels = series.data_labels
data_labels.font.size = Pt(11)
data_labels.font.color.rgb = WHITE
data_labels.number_format = '0.0"%"'
data_labels.label_position = XL_LABEL_POSITION.OUTSIDE_END

cat_axis = chart.category_axis
cat_axis.tick_labels.font.size = Pt(11)
cat_axis.tick_labels.font.color.rgb = WHITE
cat_axis.format.line.fill.background()
cat_axis.major_tick_mark = 2  # none

val_axis = chart.value_axis
val_axis.visible = False
val_axis.format.line.fill.background()
val_axis.major_gridlines.format.line.fill.background()

chart.chart_style = 2
element = chart.element
plot_area = element.find('.//{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/chart}plotArea')
from lxml import etree
sp_pr = plot_area.find('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/chart}spPr')
if sp_pr is None:
    sp_pr = etree.SubElement(plot_area, '{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/chart}spPr')

# Right side: key callouts
add_rect(slide, Inches(8.3), Inches(1.6), Inches(4.5), Inches(1.5), CARD_BG)
add_text(slide, Inches(8.5), Inches(1.7), Inches(4), Inches(0.5),
         "Chinese Providers Combined", size=16, color=LIGHT, bold=True)
add_text(slide, Inches(8.5), Inches(2.2), Inches(4), Inches(0.7),
         "54.3%", size=44, color=ACCENT, bold=True)

add_rect(slide, Inches(8.3), Inches(3.4), Inches(4.5), Inches(1.2), CARD_BG)
add_text(slide, Inches(8.5), Inches(3.5), Inches(4), Inches(0.4),
         "Xiaomi leads at 25.9%", size=15, color=WHITE)
add_text(slide, Inches(8.5), Inches(3.95), Inches(4), Inches(0.4),
         "More than 2× the runner-up (Google)", size=13, color=LIGHT)

add_rect(slide, Inches(8.3), Inches(4.9), Inches(4.5), Inches(1.2), CARD_BG)
add_text(slide, Inches(8.5), Inches(5.0), Inches(4), Inches(0.4),
         "OpenAI ranks only 5th at 7.9%", size=15, color=WHITE)
add_text(slide, Inches(8.5), Inches(5.45), Inches(4), Inches(0.4),
         "Highly fragmented — no provider > 30%", size=13, color=LIGHT)

add_text(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(6.8), Inches(10), Inches(0.4),
         "Note: Provider shares represent total market including models outside the top 10.",
         size=11, color=LIGHT)

# ── Slide 4: Market Shifts ──
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
set_bg(slide)
slide_title(slide, "Shifts in the Market Landscape")

shifts = [
    ("Chinese Models Dominate Globally", "54%+",
     "Xiaomi, Stepfun, DeepSeek, MiniMax, and Zhipu\ncombined hold over half of all usage on this\ninternational platform."),
    ("Flash/Turbo Variants Win", "Top Usage",
     "Step 3.5 Flash, GLM 5 Turbo, Gemini 3 Flash —\n'fast and affordable' models far outpace flagships\nin real-world deployment."),
    ("Anthropic Growth Stalled", "~0% WoW",
     "Despite two models in the top 10, Anthropic's\ncombined token usage shows near-zero\nweek-over-week growth."),
    ("Market Expanding Rapidly", "2T → 26T",
     "Weekly token usage grew from ~2T to ~26T\nover the past year — a 13× increase in total\nplatform throughput."),
]

for i, (title, metric, desc) in enumerate(shifts):
    col = i % 2
    row = i // 2
    x = Inches(0.8 + col * 6.2)
    y = Inches(1.6 + row * 2.8)
    add_rect(slide, x, y, Inches(5.8), Inches(2.4), CARD_BG)
    add_text(slide, x + Inches(0.3), y + Inches(0.2), Inches(3.5), Inches(0.4),
             title, size=18, color=WHITE, bold=True)
    add_text(slide, x + Inches(3.8), y + Inches(0.15), Inches(1.7), Inches(0.5),
             metric, size=28, color=ACCENT, bold=True, align=PP_ALIGN.RIGHT)
    add_text(slide, x + Inches(0.3), y + Inches(0.8), Inches(5.2), Inches(1.5),
             desc, size=13, color=LIGHT)

# ── Slide 5: Rising Stars ──
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
set_bg(slide)
slide_title(slide, "This Week's Rising Stars: Fastest-Growing Models")

risers = [
    ("MiniMax M2.7", "MiniMax", "+253%", "New model launch drives massive adoption;\njumped straight to #3 overall."),
    ("MiMo-V2-Pro", "Xiaomi", "+165%", "Cost-performance leader captures top position\nwith 3.96T tokens in one week."),

    add_rect(slide, x, Inches(1.6), Inches(3.7), Inches(2.6), CARD_BG)

    add_text(slide, x + Inches(0.3), Inches(2.15), Inches(2), Inches(0.3),

    add_text(slide, x + Inches(2.2), Inches(2.1), Inches(1.2), Inches(0.4),

    add_rect(slide, x, Inches(4.5), Inches(3.7), Inches(2.3), CARD_BG)
    add_text(slide, x + Inches(0.3), Inches(4.6), Inches(3.1), Inches(0.4),

    add_text(slide, x + Inches(0.3), Inches(5.0), Inches(2), Inches(0.3),

    add_text(slide, x + Inches(2.2), Inches(4.95), Inches(1.2), Inches(0.4),

    add_text(slide, x + Inches(0.3), Inches(5.45), Inches(3.1), Inches(1.0),

slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
set_bg(slide)
slide_title(slide, "App Ecosystem: Who's Calling These Models")

apps = [
    ("OpenClaw", "AI productivity assistant", "829B/day", 100),
    ("Kilo Code", "VS Code AI coding assistant", "271B/day", 33),
    ("Claude Code", "Anthropic CLI coding tool", "78B/day", 9.4),
    ("Cline", "VS Code autonomous coding agent", "69.1B/day", 8.3),
    ("Janitor AI", "Character roleplay chat", "29.2B/day", 3.5),
]

bar_max_w = Inches(7.0)
for i, (name, desc, vol, pct) in enumerate(apps):
    y = Inches(1.7 + i * 1.05)
    add_text(slide, Inches(0.8), y, Inches(2.8), Inches(0.35),

    add_text(slide, Inches(0.8), y + Inches(0.32), Inches(2.8), Inches(0.3),

    bar_w = int(bar_max_w * pct / 100)

    add_text(slide, Inches(3.8) + bar_w + Inches(0.15), y + Inches(0.05), Inches(1.5), Inches(0.45),
             vol, size=14, color=WHITE, bold=True)

# Callout
add_rect(slide, Inches(8.5), Inches(5.5), Inches(4.3), Inches(1.5), CARD_BG)
add_text(slide, Inches(8.7), Inches(5.6), Inches(3.9), Inches(0.4),
         "Key Insight", size=16, color=ACCENT, bold=True)
add_text(slide, Inches(8.7), Inches(6.0), Inches(3.9), Inches(0.8),
         "Top 4 apps are all AI coding tools.\nCoding agents are now the single largest\nLLM consumption category.",
         size=13, color=LIGHT)

# ── Slide 7: Key Takeaways ──
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
set_bg(slide)
slide_title(slide, "Key Insights and Industry Implications")

takeaways = [
    ("Chinese Models Hold Dominant Global Share",
     "Over 54% of usage on this international platform comes from Chinese providers — "
     "Xiaomi, MiniMax, Stepfun, DeepSeek, and Zhipu. Cost-performance advantage is the key driver."),
    ("AI Coding Agents Are the #1 LLM Use Case",
     "5 of the top 10 apps are coding tools. OpenClaw alone consumes 829B tokens/day. "
     "Developers are the largest and most engaged LLM user base."),
    ("The Market Is Highly Fragmented",
     "Top 10 models span 8 providers. No single provider exceeds 30% share. "
     "Competition remains fierce and the landscape is far from settled."),
    ("Fast & Affordable Models Win in Practice",
     "Flash and Turbo variants (Step 3.5 Flash, GLM 5 Turbo, Gemini 3 Flash) "
     "far outpace flagship models. Speed and cost trump peak benchmarks in real deployment."),
]

for i, (title, desc) in enumerate(takeaways):
    col = i % 2
    row = i // 2
    x = Inches(0.8 + col * 6.2)
    y = Inches(1.6 + row * 2.8)
    num_color = ACCENT
    add_rect(slide, x, y, Inches(5.8), Inches(2.4), CARD_BG)
